verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents grouping identical and similar exceptions into one error while still letting you navigate individual occurrences (docs-3, docs-47). It also documents customizing grouping by changing the error class, component, or stack trace, or by sending a custom fingerprint (docs-2). A community user independently praises the deduping (comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit detail that the default rules fingerprint on the stack trace (docs-47 is truncated), and documentation of how a custom fingerprint is configured or sent from the client.
